tools.name: create_listing
tools.description: Create a car-for-sale listing for a PRIVATE seller on AutoPrivado, only on behalf of and with the consent of the car's owner. tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Get one AutoPrivado listing by id: vehicle data, price and currency, texts in 7 languages, photo URLs, page URL per language, missing-info checklist. Expired or deleted listings return not_found.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search active private-seller car listings on AutoPrivado. Filters: free text (make/model), make, model, market country, price range with currency, max km, min year, fuel. A country search also returns cars cross-listed into that market (crossListed, marketPrice, marketCurrency); price filters use th

tools.name: decode_vehicle
tools.description: Decode a 17-character VIN (NHTSA vPIC, works best for cars sold in the US and many EU makes) or a Dutch licence plate (RDW open data: make, model, first registration, fuel, power, APK date). Returns the vehicle data AutoPrivado would use. Nothing is stored.

tools.name: estimate_price
tools.description: Rule-based price range (low/mid/high, EUR) for a used car from its VIN or Dutch plate (or make/model/year), mileage, condition and the approximate price when new. Not a valuation; it explains every step and the typical dealer gap. Polish listings are priced in PLN by the seller; this estimate is alw

tools.name: list_portals
tools.description: The car portals AutoPrivado prepares posting kits for, per country (IT, ES, DE, FR, NL, PL): recommended and optional portal, home page, the portal's own listing form, private-seller fee with its source, optional payment service, and whether a seller from abroad can use it.

tools.name: get_sale_documents
tools.description: Links and data for closing a private car sale in a country: printable sale-contract template (prefilled when a listing id is given), the change-of-ownership checklist with deadlines (computed from the sale date), documents to hand over, costs and official sources.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_listing" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
